pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Bug fix matching the PR title. It adds a message and no new options. The only choice, empty table versus no match, is stated in the PR body.
No spec file in this change.

Three new tests cover no match, HTML escaping of the search, and an empty table. The first would fail on the old code. The empty-table test deletes all rows, but it runs last in its file. I did not run the suite; CI covers it.
The diff touches no docs files, and I found no doc mentioning the message.

The message is only computed when results are empty and q is set. The count query is correct. The escaped q goes into the message and the page template uses the message as-is, so there is no double escaping.
q is escaped with escapeHtml before it goes into the HTML. A test covers it. The SQL is parameterised.
The only UI change is one text string in the server-rendered HTML.
No browser flow or UI file changed beyond one message string.
Title is under 72 characters. The body claims match the diff.
